ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT day of June,2012,between Assouline Ritz 1, LLC and Lichten Ritz 2, LLC, New York limited liability companies, each having an office at 140 West 57th Street, Suite 6B,New York,New York 10019 (hereinafter collectively referred to as "Owner"), and DDG Warren LLC, a New York limited liability company, having its office at c/o DDG Partners LLC, 250 Hudson Street, 10th Floor, New York, New York 10013 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the sponsor of the offering plan for The Tribeca Townhomes at 16 Warren Street Condominium (the “Offering Plan") for the premises located in the City, County and State of New York, known as the street address 16 Warren Street, New York,New York 10007, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and designated as Block 135, Lots 1701-1706 on the New York City Tax Map (said land and tax lot being hereinafter WHEREAS, Lot A is improved with a nine-story building with a mezzanine, which building has been subjected to the Condominium Act of the State of New York; said buildings and improvements located on Lot A, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “Condominium's Building", and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as the “Condominium's Property". The Declaration of Condominium establishing The Tribeca Townhomes at the 16 Warren Street Condominium (the “Condominium") was recorded in the office of the New York City Register (the “Register") on September 12, 2008 as CRFN 2008000363277(collectively the“Declaration").The owners of units in the Condominium are hereinafter referred to as “Unit Owners".
